description.value: Rowena's Inn on the River is the heritage inn wing of Sandpiper Resort, a full-service riverside property set along the Fraser River near Harrison Mills in the Fraser Valley. The inn offers character-named rooms with river and forest views, sitting alongside rustic cabins, Scandinavian-styled luxury nature cabins, RV sites, a par-72 golf course, and an on-site restaurant. Touring cyclists arriving here would find a scenic, well-appointed stop with multiple accommodation tiers and on-site dining in a striking mountain-and-river landscape.

address.value: 14282 Morris Valley Rd. Harrison Mills, BC, Canada V0M 1L0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sandpiperresort.ca/stay/ confirms that 'Rowena's Inn' is a named inn section (rooms: Charlie's Room, Ivan's Suite, Betty-Anne's Room, Pete's Room, Rose Room) within the broader Sandpiper Resort property. The /contact/ page provides the physical address (Harrison Mills, BC) and phone number, neither of which appear in the OSM record. No bicycle-specific amenities — storage, tools, wash, laundry, or e-bike charging — are mentioned anywhere on the website, so those fields are null; the on-site River's Edge Clubhouse restaurant is confirmed to serve lunch and dinner, supporting 'Nearby evening food' as true.
concerns: OSM community is listed as 'Chilliwack' but the physical address is Harrison Mills, BC — a distinct community roughly 30 km east of Chilliwack.
OSM name 'Rowena's Inn on the River' refers to one inn wing of the larger Sandpiper Resort; the OSM record and website URL point to the full resort's stay page rather than a standalone inn property.

OSM record contains no phone number or address; both were sourced entirely from the website's /contact/ page, so contact_confirmed fields for phone and address are null (no OSM values to corroborate).
